# Result: completed prose

A plan-less folder whose result carries a `**Completed`-prefixed *prose* header rather than the
closing `**Completed:** YYYY-MM-DD` line a `done` plan owes. On a folder with no plan the result's
content is the whole lifecycle, so a loose match here reads unfinished work as terminal — and the
`done-unarchived` finding that follows is what `maintain`'s archive gate moves on one confirmation.
